request.style: English, female solo voice with choir, harp, flute, piano, soft drums, gentle and majestic mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
King Rehoboam took a wife
Her name was Mahalath the light
She came from David's house
Daughter of Jerimoth

[Chorus]
Daughter of Jerimoth
Blood of the ancient king
Mother of sons three
Hear the story she brings

[Verse]
Her mother was Abihail
Daughter of Eliab
From Jesse's line she came
Walking in an ancient way

[Chorus]
Daughter of Jerimoth
Blood of the ancient king
Mother of sons three
Hear the story she brings

[Bridge]
She bore him Jeush first
Shemariah and Zaham
Names recorded in the book
Sons of her and of the king

[Outro]
Mahalath the wife
Daughter of Jerimoth
The history of her sons
Kept in the royal scroll
